definition: Scoring intermediate steps rather than only the final answer, so that a long trajectory carries signal at the points where credit is ambiguous. Across 15 sources the recurring finding is that it works only as a modifier on the terminal check: removing the sequence-level quality reward is the single largest degradation in one system while removing the process reward costs less than either that or removing reinforcement learning entirely, and pushing the process weight too high drives performance below the baseline it was meant to improve. Designs accordingly constrain it -- gating partial agreement with a reference so it cannot override a wrong final answer, applying the turn-level term multiplicatively so it reweights the trajectory advantage's magnitude while preserving its sign, or giving distinct trajectory segments separate advantage terms so an update improving one is not cancelled by the other sharing one scalar. The sources disagree about where the signal should come from and each choice carries its own defect. A learned verifier is informative and expensive -- the sparse-supervision trap one source names. A frozen reference policy's teacher-forced likelihood of a gold answer is cheap but exists only where a gold target does, so nothing transfers to inference or to reference-free settings, and it inherits the references' domain bias. Reusing step labels that process-annotation datasets already contain is cheapest of all, but the reward then measures agreement with one validated derivation, so a rollout reaching the verified answer through different intermediate quantities is penalised for being different rather than wrong -- and coverage is bounded by the annotations the premise says others pay to create. Hand-written criteria check surface quality of a trace rather than grounding, so a fluent well-structured passage unsupported by the evidence is rewarded. Ablations that remove it typically cost a few points (65.15 and 65.24 against a full method's 67.94 in one), which is the scale of contribution the archive should expect.

evidence.note: Gives each retrieval step of a search agent a dense reward built from two ground-truth-conditioned signals — how much the step raised the model's likelihood of the correct answer, and how necessary the step looks in hindsight — and fuses them asymmetrically so that a step which helps locally but is redundant globally is discounted.
evidence.title: BiCAA: Bidirectional Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Agent

evidence.note: Supervises audio reasoning with per-question rubrics generated from the raw waveform, and keeps the signal alive as the policy improves by regenerating the rubrics from the model's own rollouts each step and pruning any criterion that every rollout satisfies or none does.
evidence.title: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics as Rewards for Audio Reasoning

evidence.note: Scores each reasoning step of a translation by how much appending it raises a frozen reference model's teacher-forced likelihood of the gold translation, and adds that as a dense per-step reward on top of sequence-level quality — after first establishing that explicit reasoning helps long and hard inputs while drifting on terminology and style.
evidence.title: PAMT: Process-Aligned Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Domain Machine Translation

evidence.note: Recasts long-document visual question answering as building an explicit evidence graph whose nodes are grounded document blocks and whose edges are reasoning dependencies, and verifies the graph causally — masking the evidence it cites flips 82.8% of correct answers while masking uncited evidence changes 9.6%.
evidence.title: DocTrace: Towards Traceable Long Document VQA via Hierarchical Evidence Graph Reasoning

evidence.note: Turns table-to-report generation into Monte Carlo tree search over partial reports, scored by a reward that verifies every numerical claim by generating and executing SQL against the source table rather than by asking a judge — and keeps that search reward strictly separate from the benchmark's own evaluator to avoid a reward-hacking loop.
evidence.title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Table-to-Multimodal Report Generation

evidence.note: Couples KV-cache compression and generation-length control under a single process-reward signal, compressing harder at high-reward reasoning steps and stopping early when confidence is high.
evidence.title: Fewer Tokens, Smaller Cache: Reward-Coordinated Efficient Reasoning

evidence.note: Distributes hindsight supervision across the turns of an agent trajectory by comparing each turn's share of total revision magnitude against its share of eligible tokens, holding the average multiplier at one so the total supervision is fixed and only its allocation changes -- and isolates that allocation with a permutation control that keeps the multiplier values and scrambles which turn receives which.
evidence.title: Trajectory-Relative Hindsight Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

evidence.note: Replaces the monotonic zoom-in that tool-using video agents follow once they pick a region with a policy that self-checks each tool observation and can switch regions, and trains it with turn-level credit applied multiplicatively -- reweighting the trajectory advantage's magnitude while preserving its sign -- rather than additively.
evidence.title: SCOUT: Self-Checking and Recovery-Aware Tool-Thought Agents for Ultra-Long Egocentric Video Reasoning

evidence.note: Trains a multimodal agent to orchestrate twelve video-analysis tools for anomaly detection with GRPO under a dual reward that combines exact-match rule checks with an LLM judge scoring logicality, relevance and completeness, and releases the benchmark it is evaluated on.
evidence.title: VTO: Visual Tool Orchestration for Video Anomaly Detection

evidence.note: Builds a dense process reward without a learned verifier or an online judge, by aligning generated reasoning steps to the process-labelled reference steps that existing datasets already contain using numerical, symbolic and lexical matching rules, gated so a partial reference match cannot override a wrong final answer.
evidence.title: StructReward: Efficient Structured Process Rewards for Self-Correcting Multimodal Reasoning

evidence.note: Replaces the single tolerance threshold that RLVR uses to score floating-point answers with a hybrid reward pairing a hard clinical-safety constraint against a continuous precision-sensitive term, and adds a reward for stating the computational formula explicitly so an external verifier can check it.
evidence.title: MedCalc-R1: Knowledge-Guided Reward Framework for Medical Mathematical Reasoning

evidence.note: Trains self-correction as a step-level preference problem -- preferring a detect-and-repair continuation over the continuation that would follow if the error went unaddressed -- after first initialising with ordinary step-level preference optimisation, and finds that correcting more often and detecting more errors both anti-correlate with accuracy.
evidence.title: Reinforcing Step-level Reasoning for Effective Self-Correction in LLMs

evidence.note: Names and measures a multilingual tool-calling failure in which the model picks the right API but writes argument values in the wrong language, then compares supervised fine-tuning against PPO and GRPO under matched budgets and finds that a well-selected supervised checkpoint matches or beats reinforcement learning on the task while costing more elsewhere.
evidence.title: When the API Speaks the Wrong Language: Revisiting Post-Training for Multilingual Tool Use

evidence.note: Gives a search agent an explicitly reversible trajectory tree with reflect and backtrack as first-class actions, and trains the reflection policy with a dense local signal distilled from a teacher that can see the whole trajectory alongside the sparse terminal reward the local decision is ultimately judged by.
evidence.title: LoongReflect: Boosting Long-Horizon Reflection in Search Agents via Global Perspective Distillation

evidence.note: Splits a spatial-reasoning chain of thought into explicitly typed segments -- perception, including depth, and reasoning -- and gives each its own process reward and its own advantage term, so that the two do not compete for credit under a single outcome signal.
evidence.title: SCOUT: Unlocking Enhanced Spatial Reasoning via Structured Chain-of-Thought and Multi-Objective Process Reward

name: process reward
